title: A Garden for the Salt
author: Vesper Iversen
blurb: Rafael Whitlock, a cartographer of unmapped realms, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
